# dsh-prompt-chips
A quick-prompt menu in the composer tool row of the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
The trigger is a small lightning button beside the attach, permission and plan controls. Click it to
open a menu of saved prompts; picking one inserts it into the composer at the caret. Arrow keys mov
e through the menu, Enter picks, Escape closes.
## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI. The package declares both `dsh.bundle` and `dsh.client`, and its

`engines.dsh` is `>=0.2.0-rc.1 || >=0.2.1-rc.1 || >=0.2.2-rc.1`.
- No other plugin is required.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

## Use

1. Open a Session in the Web UI.
2. Click the lightning button in the composer tool row.
3. Pick a p
rompt, or choose **Edit prompts…** to change them.
The four default prompts cover continuing, summarising the conversation, explaining code and writing
tests. Edits are stored in the browser (`localStorage`) and never leave the machine; an empty field
falls back to its default text.
## Notes

- UI text follows the active Harness locale; English and Chinese ship with the plugin.
- Colors come
from the Harness theme tokens, so the menu follows light and dark themes.
